body:
TL;DR: No "/home" link exists anywhere in the repo. The [404] /home requests do NOT come from this codebase. Nav links are all correct (`/`, `/about/`, `/#projects`, `/blog/`, `/cv/`). Hypothesis: browser/extension rewrite, stale Vercel redirect, or external referrer — not source.

Investigation findings:

1. Navigation component is NOT src/components/Navigation.tsx — actual file is src/components/UI/Navigation.tsx. Nav link array at lines 5-11:
   - L5: `{ href: '/about/', label: 'About' }`
   - L6: `{ href: '/#projects', label: 'Projects' }`
   - L7: `{ href: '/blog/', label: 'Blog' }`
   - L8: `{ href: '/cv/', label: 'CV' }`
   - L9: `https://github.com/ktappdev`
   - Logo link `<a href="/">` at L84. Mobile menu reuses same array (L143).
   - No "Home" link exists in nav at all (home accessed via logo).

2. Repo-wide grep for `"/home"` / `'/home'` / `/home`: ZERO hits across src/, public/, astro.config.mjs, dist/ (built output), and full git history (git log -S + git grep on rev-list).

3. All pages define breadcrumb Home as `/`: src/pages/cv/index.astro:18, src/pages/blog/[slug].astro:92, src/pages/blog/index.astro:21, src/pages/blog/tag/[tag].astro:25, src/pages/blog/search.astro:14, src/pages/about/index.astro:21 — all `{ name: 'Home', path: '/' }`.

4. Homepage confirmed at src/pages/index.astro → renders at "/". src/pages/ contains index.astro, 404.astro, about/, blog/, cv/, landing/sshthing/, og/. No home.astro.

5. Rendered dist/ HTML verified: nav hrefs in output are `/`, `/about/`, `/#projects`, `/blog/`, `/cv/` — correct.

6. No redirects config: astro.config.mjs has no redirects, no vercel.json exists.

7. Git history: Search link (`/blog/search/`) removed from nav in commit e05219c — not home-related. No "/home" ever existed.

Likely causes for [404] /home (outside codebase):
- Browser extension or old bookmarked link rewriting
- Vercel platform-level redirect/config outside repo
- Referrer from external site linking to kentaylor.dev/home
- Astro ClientRouter view-transition issue (unlikely — hrefs are literal `/`)

Next step suggestion: check Vercel dashboard redirects config + browser devtools network panel to see what actually fires the /home request. No source fix needed.
